newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Former Russian minister named Rosneft chairman.
newsitem.headline: Former Russian minister named Rosneft chairman.

text.p: The Russian government has appointed former industry minister Yury Bespalov chairman of the board of state oil holding company Rosneft, Interfax quoted a government resolution as saying on Monday.
Rosneft's press service confirmed the resolution had been signed but declined to comment on it, saying a news conference would be held on the subject at 3 p.m. (1100 GMT) on Monday.
Interfax quoted the resolution as saying former chairman Alexander Putilov had been relieved of his duties at his own request in connection with a new job.
The government will appoint the chairman of OAO NK Rosneft, which is due to be privatised later this year, until the first general meeting of shareholders.
Interfax has said the government will retain 51 percent of Rosneft shares for three years, two percent of shares will go to employees and 47 percent will be auctioned off.
The industry ministry was abolished during the government restructuring earlier this year.
